text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To review, our perpetrators are using the door in the back of 
the library to sneak into the archive room.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We will investigate the archive room to find traces of intruders, 
irregularities, and any other clues we can find!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Yes ma'am! Let's goooo! 
Okayyyy! You got it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see… The door's hidden behind boxes and books, so 
it would be difficult to find without prior knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There's a rope sticking out under the shelf. 
That's suspicious… I'm gonna give it a pull!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hnnnnngh, it's not budging… 
What the heck is this tied to??

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-Windy-san! You shouldn't keep pulling on it! 
What if the shelf falls over!? Drop it, now!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
This stack of crates is really in the way. 
Better shove 'em all somewhere else!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: One! Two! Puuuuuuuuush!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Big-san!? They're going to fall! Be careful! 
Please, move them one at a time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wowie! Someone wrote on the wall! Let's see… 
"I suck at reading the pace! The front runners always 
pull me ahead"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I'll write back ♪ 
"You're a pace chaser? Urara"…

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: U-Urara-san!? You shouldn't vandalize the wall!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's okay! This pen washes off!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not okay! 
If you insist on writing a reply, use a sticky note!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What is that above the shelf? A vent? 
Now that's suspicious! I bet I'll find a clue in there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But it's too high even with the step stool… 
Wait, I know! If I jump with a running start——!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pegasuuuuus……!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
STOOOOOOOOOOOOP! Don't! It's dangerous! 
Absolutely no jumping or running in the school rooms!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-wait…! E-everyone…! 
………………………………………Nggghhh…

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
URARA! BIG! BIKO! WINDY! 
ALL UNITS, TO ME! NOW!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Good grief! You are all uncontrollable! 
No more reckless behavior!! From now on you are to consult 
with me before taking action. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Understood… 
……Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm closing the investigation for today. 
Good work, everyone! Let's all give our best efforts tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
…… 
…Yeah… See you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(…That look on her face… 
Why is her bitter expression… digging a pit in my stomach…?)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(…No… I recognize it, somewhere deep down. 
…I've tasted this bitterness before.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
In grade school, my classmates started playing soccer in the 
classroom. I warned them about their reckless behavior, and 
forced them to stop.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My father praised me. He told me I was brave, that I did the 
right thing. When I heard those words from him, the man 
I respected so much… I was so overjoyed, I…

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I saw a group of noisy adults loitering in front of a convenience 
store. I told them off, warning them that they were being a 
nuisance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately for me, they were reasonable enough to listen. 
But when I told my father about it… 
He gave me a harsh scolding.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm older, I realize that he was only trying to 
protect me. But the only thing my young mind understood was 
that I got scolded when I thought I would be praised.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It sent a shock through my system. 
…Like my entire sense of self had be called into question.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (…Did I…)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Did I force them to feel the same pain…?)
